headline: Annual inflation is 5.7% in September, and the cumulative rate over 5 years reaches 42.4%
summary: Bulgaria's annual inflation rate was 5.7% in September, with the cumulative rate over five years at 42.4%. Prices rose in 11 of the statistical groups, while only three categories showed declines.
why: Inflation data shapes central bank policy and the outlook for interest rates, wages and purchasing power, which matter for investors in Bulgarian assets and the euro-area economy.
